description: Aider-polyglot style (Java), built for the repair round: an integer expression evaluator with a hand-written parser. The natural first implementation folds ^ left to right, so 2^3^2 gives 64 instead of 512, binds unary minus tighter than ^, so -2^2 gives 4 instead of -4, and lets long overflow or Long.MIN_VALUE / -1 pass silently; the tests catch all of these, so the post-turn verifier's second round has to fix them. A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs a plain Java test runner.
